rationale_bullets: Moore returns as a Heisman favorite: 90.2 PFF/480 dropbacks (B10 +1 -> 91.2, ~p93), 3,565-3,665 yds by book, 30-10, 72% completion (top five), #5 P4 QB rating, and a 27-of-30 (90%) game vs Minnesota.
He 'surprised by returning' after a projected first-round grade (P6); PS: 'could be the top QB in the 2027 draft.' The one blemish: 'a rough game' in the semifinal (PS).

The QB2 is unprecedented for this set: Raiola (62.4/305 at Nebraska; 2,000 @ 72%, 19-5) transferred in BEFORE Moore's return and stayed anyway - 'a developmental year before gunning for the 2027 job' (P6).
The tempering: an internal OC promotion (Mehringer) rather than continuity of the caller.
89, H = one notch under Sayin (91): nearly identical adjusted tape, elite depth, minor transition noise.
data_gaps: Semi wobble as signal vs noise

rationale_bullets: The freshman duo owns the room: Davison (89.1 PFF/113 att; 667 @ 5.9, 15 TD; 236-lb bruiser) + Hill (90.8/74; 656 @ 8.7-8.8 - the nation's best yards/carry). PS: 'could be the first Duck duo to each top 1,000 since 2008'; 'my #3 RB corps in the FBS.'
The revealed-preference tell: their emergence 'sent three other backs to the portal' (P6) - Limar (UW), Harris (KSU), Hughes (Houston) - and Whittington (83.3/129; 829 @ 6.4) graduated.
Depth restocked with Top100 FR Ball (PS#4) and Price (Colorado).
Sample honesty: 187 combined attempts - elite rate stats on freshman volume; the duo aggregate (~89.8, ~p92) is graded down for it.
80, M = the set's second-best RB room behind nobody proven-at-volume; Athlon's 'thunder and lightning.'

The five-star pair returns healthy: Dakorien Moore (74.5/235 -> 73.5; the #1 WR recruit of 2025) + Evan Stewart (yr4 MEDICAL override RETURNS - missed all 2025 with the fall-camp knee; 613 @ 12.8 in 2024) - 'an elite one-two punch' (P6), with McClellan (71.8/275) as the third starter and 'position-less' usage planned.
The best incoming tape is the X-factor: Hooks (82.3 PFF/356 routes at UAB, AAC +0; ~900 yds) - plus two MORE five-stars (Lott, Bair).

TE: Sadiq (70.9/346; the first TE drafted - yr3 declare) leaves, but J.Johnson (78.1/208 -> 77.1) 'was matching Sadiq's performance' over the back half (P6); Top50s Olesh (PSU) + Harrison behind. Athlon: 'minimal drop-off.'
GONE: Benson (73.0/277; rd-6) and Bryant (yr4). RECV 88p as-played.
Weighted aggregate ~76.3 (~p95) on real volumes; no Smith-class alpha but the deepest blue-chip breadth in the set. 80, M.

Three All-B10 starters are gone - including the room's best tape (Pregnon 87.0/910) plus both tackles (World 65.4/844, Harkey 64.8/887) - from a Joe Moore-finalist line (PBLK 98p / RBLK 81p, 16 sacks).
What returns: Laloulu (69.1/884 -> 68.1) - PS's 1st-team ALL-AMERICAN center who 'spurned the NFL draft' - and 3rd-year guard Iuli (61.9/907 -> 60.9), plus Rogers (67.7/108).

The bet is stated: 'the staff declined the transfer portal this cycle and doubled down on their recent blue-chip recruiting' (P6) - LT is 4* Crader (61.1/138) vs Top100 Addison; a FR (Utu) prints at RG; Bennett (Yale) is the lone import. 52 career starts (PS).
Mechanical: returning aggregate ~64.7 (~p47); PS's 'remain strong' and the pipeline argue up; the tackle rebuild with zero P4 imports argues down.
56, M = the roster's one ordinary unit - and its clearest failure tail.

THE ENTIRE STARTING FRONT RETURNS - all four juniors explicitly skipping the draft (Athlon): Tuioti (83.8 PFF/705 -> 93.8), Uiagalelei (82.2/726 -> 92.2; led the B10 in sacks in 2024), Washington (80.0/656 -> 90.0), Alexander (73.3/581 -> 83.3).
The consensus is unanimous: 'this could be the best four-man front in the country' (Athlon); 'my #2 rated DLine' (PS); 2025 as-played PRSH 91p / RDEF 80p (116 rush ypg at 3.4).
The revealed-preference tell: all four BACKUPS transferred to P4 rosters with four-star grades (Porter/Green/Gray/Purchase) - blocked, not bad.
Depth restock: Robinson (67.7/377, UNC starter), five-stars Rushing + A.Jones, Top200s Wyatt + Breland, Dixon (Clemson).
Mechanical starter aggregate ~90.4 - at the Kentucky-91 anchor with individually better tapes. 90, H: the first 90-grade defensive unit of the project, settled and proven at volume.
data_gaps: Rotation snaps behind the four (backup exodus)

rationale_bullets: The anchor leaves: Boettcher (77.6 PFF/777) - 136 tackles, the most by a Duck since 1979, Burlsworth winner, rd-4. (NB Canady counted at DB.)
Two live returners: Mixon (72.9/560 -> 88.9; 'a breakout 2025 season' - Athlon) and Jackson (66.1/370 -> 82.1; Top100 with 'sprinter speed... poised to finally break out' - P6).
The staff 'ignored the portal here' (P6) - depth is Nix (72.4/45), Platt, and three four-star freshmen; PS: 'down a few notches.'
Mechanical pair aggregate ~86.2 (~p88); LB caution + the departed leader + unproven depth = 66, M.

The returning core is young and real: Finney (78.9 PFF/694 -> 84.9) - FRESHMAN All-America, 'one of the best corners, period' (Athlon) - plus FR-year starter Obidegwu (67.7/423 -> 73.7), S Flowers (68.0/741 -> 74.0), 5* Offord (58.2/245; breakout flag), Woodyard (72.4/172).
The losses are the two best tapes: Thieneman (90.8/812 - All-American; yr3 declare override; the best DB tape in this B10 round) and NB Canady (85.5/603; rd-4).

The imports: Perich (61.0/789 at Minnesota - the #1 transfer safety; two-time All-B10 whose 2025 slump tape is documented in the Minnesota build; the bet is 2024 form), Scott (64.8/106; OSU 5*), C.Williams (Baylor; NB); five-stars McNutt + J.Washington pack the two-deep.
P6: 'I don't think I've seen this amount of raw firepower in any defensive backfield in Pick Six Previews' history'; PS: 'my #2 secondary.' COV 94p as-played.
Mechanical aggregate ~75.0 (~p80); the Thieneman/Canady subtraction and the Perich form bet land it at 74, M.
ST rule: start at the 88th-percentile prior SPEC (PS STR #23; #11 the year before) and adjust: BOTH legs are gone - K (19-24) and P (38.4 net).

The system stays: ST coach Lorig retained ('#4, #23 and #34 units at Penn St... 3 Top 10 at Memphis' - PS). Replacements: Emmett (Nevada) vs returners Hurych/Graziano; Athlon prints P Ettridge* + LS Todd* (feed-gap arrivals, print-verified).
The return game upgrades: Perich (Minnesota's elite PR/KR - 6.7/26.3 in 2024-25) at KR, D.Moore at PR.
62, M - PS: 'should remain strong'; the legs are the unknowns.
